rows: Select a procedure and configure its dialog.

Choose the procedure before opening its dialog.

how.h2: From your data folder to the R output

steps.h3: Choose the folder containing your data
steps.p: Blade reads your existing files. Scripts, tables, and plots are saved in the same project folder.
Blade reads the variables, proposes a method, and explains its choice before running the analysis.
steps.quote: "Does treatment affect the outcome after adjusting for baseline score and age?"

steps.h3: Read the results and inspect the script
steps.p: Review the APA output, tables, plots, and assumption checks. Open the saved R script to inspect or rerun the analysis.

methods.sub: Blade calls these procedures through R. Each result comes from the procedure output, with the code saved for review.

trust.h2: Check the method, assumptions, and R script

points.p: Each p-value comes from an R procedure. Blade selects the procedure and explains its output.
Convergence warnings, singular fits, and assumption failures appear with the output. Failed analyses are reported as failures.
Every analysis saves its R script in your folder. A supervisor or statistician can inspect it without installing Blade.
Blade uses R and Python on your computer. Data files stay in your folder. File writes and shell commands require approval.
points.p2: The hosted API plans the analysis and stores the session transcript. Your workspace files stay on your computer.

points.p: Check whether the comparison answers your research question. Review confounders, study design, and interpretation alongside the procedure output.

cross.h3: Save the analysis as a workflow
cross.p: Run the same analysis on next month's files. Share it with a colleague as one .bladeworkflow file.

items.p: Run WAHA locally with Docker or connect your server. Scan the QR code in WhatsApp to pair the account.
Set workspace permissions and approve each send. Review the storage used by WhatsApp messages and files.

get.sub: Beta for macOS and Windows. Blade checks for R at startup and offers to install R and Python.
get.caveat: macOS: signed and notarized by PT Skala Teknologi Nusantara. Windows: unsigned, so SmartScreen shows a warning. Click More info, then Run anyway. Linux builds are not available yet.

faq.h2: Questions about files, R, and data
items: Do I need to know R?
No. Describe the analysis in plain language. Blade runs R and explains the output. The saved script is available for review.
Yes. Blade reads SPSS .sav files through R, preserving variable and value labels. It also reads CSV, TSV, Excel, and Parquet.
Where do the numbers come from?
R procedures calculate the results. Blade selects the procedure and explains its output. You can inspect the method and saved script.
Does my data leave my computer?
Data files stay in your project folder. The hosted API plans the analysis and stores the session transcript. Writes and commands require approval.
Review the study design, procedure choice, assumptions, and interpretation. The saved R script lets a statistician inspect and rerun the analysis.
Linux builds are not available yet. Download links for macOS and Windows are above.
